subject: CPPO activation: Acme Fintech — EU VAT & billing split
messages:
From: Lukas Stern <lukas@acmefintech.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 08:12:00 +0200
Subject: CPPO activation request + VAT handling (Acme Fintech)

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the demo last week — Acme is ready to move to a CPPO so we can purchase via our procurement team and have ResellCo manage the reseller portion. Two things we need clarified before legal will sign:

1) Billing flow and invoice split: Acme is headquartered in DE with a Germany VAT ID. We need to confirm whether the invoice will come from ResellCo (EU reseller invoice) or Redwood, and how VAT will be applied and documented.

2) SKU mapping & co-term: our FP&A wants predictable co-terming behavior (annual, starts on PO date) and a clear mapping of marketplace SKUs to Redwood SKUs for license accounting.

Can ResellCo and Redwood ops confirm the flow and provide any templates or sample invoices? We want to avoid later VAT adjustments.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — procurement is targeting the end of month.

Cheers,
Lukas
Head of Cloud Procurement
Acme Fintech
From: Gina Morales <gina@resellco.io>
To: Lukas Stern <lukas@acmefintech.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
Cc: marketplace-ops@resellco.io
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 12:34:00 +0200
Subject: Re: CPPO activation request + VAT handling (Acme Fintech)

Hi Lukas / Priya,

Happy to help. Quick answers up front: ResellCo can issue the EU invoice and handle VAT with a reverse-charge or VAT-inclusive invoice depending on the buyer's VAT registration. For DE-registered companies with a valid VAT ID, we typically issue a net invoice with reverse charge noted.

That said, for marketplace CPPOs we need to register the commercial flow in the private offer so that Acme's PO lines up with the invoice entity. I can share our billing entity docs and a sample invoice.

Next steps I propose:
- Priya / Redwood: confirm which legal entity will appear on the marketplace private offer and whether Redwood will accept the PO referencing the CPPO SKU.
- ResellCo: share tax docs + preferred billing contact for invoice routing.
- Marketplace Ops (Amazon): I will create the CPPO and mark ResellCo as the reseller; we will need to confirm settlement terms (net30 or net45).

Attaching a brief packet (see: resellco_billing_entities.pdf) and sample invoice.

Best,
Gina
Head of Partnerships, ResellCo

[Attachment: resellco_billing_entities.pdf]
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: FW: CPPO activation request + VAT handling (Acme Fintech)

Team — forwarding Acme + ResellCo thread. Key asks: EU VAT handling, invoice entity, SKU/co-term mapping. Please treat this as high priority (procurement target EOM).

What I need from you:
- Ben: confirm how we populate 'Seller of Record' and 'Bill To' fields on the CPPO so we can support ResellCo issuing the invoice to Acme without downstream reconciliation issues. Also confirm marketability of CPPO SKUs vs our internal product codes.
- Karthik: can you validate settlement cadence options and whether we can support net30 without impacting revenue recognition?
- Marissa: legal/contract note — if ResellCo issues the invoice, do we need a side letter or commercial addendum for audit/tracking?

Please reply with one consolidated action list and assign owners.

Thanks — Priya
Head of Channel Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Gina Morales <gina@resellco.io>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: CPPO activation request + VAT handling (Acme Fintech)

Gina / Priya — thanks, looping in the CPPO ops details below.

Short answers:
- On the AWS CPPO form we can populate Redwood as the 'Seller' but set ResellCo as the reseller/partner entity for settlement. For Acme's procurement, the CPPO offer text can include the reseller billing instructions ("Invoice to: ResellCo GmbH — VAT ID: DE123456789"). That satisfies most procurement teams.
- SKU mapping: attached is a one-page mapping (acme_cppo_spec.xlsx) that shows CPPO SKU -> Redwood product code and the billing unit (monthly seat vs token blocks). Use this for co-term PR/FP&A reconciliation.
- Settlement terms: Karthik, please confirm: we can accept reseller net30 provided ResellCo agrees to settlement net15 to Redwood (i.e., they invoice Acme net30 and settle us net15). This avoids revenue recognition lag for Redwood.

Requests from ResellCo:
1) Formal legal name for the invoice (exact spelling + VAT ID)
2) Billing email for invoice delivery and PO matching
3) Any reseller PO/contract number they require attached to the CPPO metadata

Action items/owners:
- Ben: upload CPPO draft to AWS CPPO console (target: 7/20) and attach acme_cppo_spec.xlsx.
- Karthik: confirm settlement cadence with finance (owner: Karthik) — due 7/20.
- Priya: confirm with Acme that reseller invoice is acceptable to procurement and capture any specific PO fields.

I have attached the mapping file.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Marketplace Ops
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: acme_cppo_spec.xlsx]
